trials.name: Four-layout mask net (reproduction)
trials.hypothesis: A faithful reproduction of the only family that has ever scored. The mask goes in as channels under four layouts (identity, transposed, y-flip, x-flip), plus coordinate channels. A 1x1 stem feeds a residual 3x3 trunk. Per-type logit maps are re-laid in the same four layouts and summed, so the network can learn whichever action indexing the world really uses. Compute ratio is about 1, so it gets the full step budget. If both seeds score 0 on dev, this world's deviation is not one of these four layouts.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
GLOB = 64
LAYOUTS = ((False, ()), (True, ()), (False, (2,)), (False, (3,)))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        nl = len(LAYOUTS)
        cin = spec.in_channels + nl * self.T + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, nl * self.T, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)

    def lay(self, m, tr, fl):
        b = m.shape[0]
        if tr:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.X, self.Y).transpose(2, 3)
        else:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        if len(fl) > 0:
            v = v.flip(fl)
        return v

    def unlay(self, o, tr, fl):
        b = o.shape[0]
        if len(fl) > 0:
            o = o.flip(fl)
        if tr:
            o = o.transpose(2, 3)
        return o.reshape(b, -1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype)
        chans = [obs]
        for tr, fl in LAYOUTS:
            chans.append(self.lay(m, tr, fl))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        chans.append(ys.view(1, 1, self.Y, 1).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        chans.append(xs.view(1, 1, 1, self.X).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(chans, dim=1))
        x = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        o = self.out(f)
        place = None
        for k, (tr, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
            p = self.unlay(o[:, k * self.T:(k + 1) * self.T], tr, fl)
            place = p if place is None else place + p
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.name: Eight-layout dihedral mask net
trials.hypothesis: The same network, with one change: it uses all eight grid symmetries (with and without transposing, each with no flip, y-flip, x-flip or both flips) for the mask channels and the re-laid logit maps.         o = o.permute(0, pos[order[0]], pos[order[1]], pos[order[2]])

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
GLOB = 64
LAYOUTS = ((False, ()), (True, ()), (False, (2,)), (False, (3,)))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        nl = len(LAYOUTS)
        cin = 3 * self.C + nl * self.T + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, nl * self.T, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)

    def lay(self, m, tr, fl):
        b = m.shape[0]
        if tr:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.X, self.Y).transpose(2, 3)
        else:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        if len(fl) > 0:
            v = v.flip(fl)
        return v

    def unlay(self, o, tr, fl):
        b = o.shape[0]
        if len(fl) > 0:
            o = o.flip(fl)
        if tr:
            o = o.transpose(2, 3)
        return o.reshape(b, -1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype)
        o1 = obs.reshape(b, self.Y, self.X, self.C).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        o2 = obs.reshape(b, self.X, self.Y, self.C).permute(0, 3, 2, 1)
        chans = [obs, o1, o2]
        for tr, fl in LAYOUTS:
            chans.append(self.lay(m, tr, fl))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        chans.append(ys.view(1, 1, self.Y, 1).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        chans.append(xs.view(1, 1, 1, self.X).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(chans, dim=1))
        x = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        o = self.out(f)
        place = None
        for k, (tr, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
            p = self.unlay(o[:, k * self.T:(k + 1) * self.T], tr, fl)
            place = p if place is None else place + p
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
PROJ = 16
HID = 64
GLOB = 64
LAYOUTS = ((False, ()), (True, ()), (False, (2,)), (False, (3,)))


def make_windows(footprints):
    wins = []
    for a, b in footprints:
        for dy, dx in ((int(a), int(b)), (int(b), int(a))):
            if dy * dx <= 1:
                continue
            for top in sorted(set([0, dy - 1])):
                for left in sorted(set([0, dx - 1])):
                    w = (dy, dx, top, left)
                    if w not in wins:
                        wins.append(w)
    return wins


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.wins = make_windows(spec.footprints)
        nl = len(LAYOUTS)
        cin = spec.in_channels + nl * self.T + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, PROJ, 1)
        hin = WIDTH + PROJ + 2 * PROJ * len(self.wins)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(hin, HID, 1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(HID, nl * self.T, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)

    def lay(self, m, tr, fl):
        b = m.shape[0]
        if tr:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.X, self.Y).transpose(2, 3)
        else:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        if len(fl) > 0:
            v = v.flip(fl)
        return v

    def unlay(self, o, tr, fl):
        b = o.shape[0]
        if len(fl) > 0:
            o = o.flip(fl)
        if tr:
            o = o.transpose(2, 3)
        return o.reshape(b, -1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype)
        chans = [obs]
        for tr, fl in LAYOUTS:
            chans.append(self.lay(m, tr, fl))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        chans.append(ys.view(1, 1, self.Y, 1).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        chans.append(xs.view(1, 1, 1, self.X).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(chans, dim=1))
        x = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        p = self.proj(f)
        feats = [f, p]
        for dy, dx, top, left in self.wins:
            pads = (left, dx - 1 - left, top, dy - 1 - top)
            mx = F.max_pool2d(F.pad(p, pads), (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(F.pad(-p, pads), (dy, dx), stride=1)
            feats.append(mx)
            feats.append(mn)
        hh = F.relu(self.mix(torch.cat(feats, dim=1)))
        o = self.out(hh)
        place = None
        for k, (tr, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
            q = self.unlay(o[:, k * self.T:(k + 1) * self.T], tr, fl)
            place = q if place is None else place + q
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 48
GLOB = 64
LAYOUTS = ((False, ()), (True, ()), (False, (2,)), (False, (3,)))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        tfs = [(False, ()), (False, (2,)), (False, (3,)), (False, (2, 3))]
        if self.Y == self.X:
            tfs = tfs + [(True, ()), (True, (2,)), (True, (3,)), (True, (2, 3))]
        self.otf = tfs
        nl = len(LAYOUTS)
        gch = 4 * self.Z + 2
        cin = gch * len(self.otf) + 1 + nl * self.T + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, nl * self.T, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)

        b = m.shape[0]

            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.X, self.Y).transpose(2, 3)
        else:
            v = m.reshape(b, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        if len(fl) > 0:
            v = v.flip(fl)
        return v

    def unlay(self, o, tr, fl):
        b = o.shape[0]
        if len(fl) > 0:
            o = o.flip(fl)
        if tr:
            o = o.transpose(2, 3)
        return o.reshape(b, -1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        b = obs.shape[0]
        Z = self.Z
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype)
        groups = [torch.cat([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1]], dim=1),
                  torch.cat([obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1),
                  obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z],
                  obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]]
        chans = [obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3]]
        for grp in groups:
            for tr, fl in self.otf:
                v = grp.transpose(2, 3) if tr else grp
                if len(fl) > 0:
                    v = v.flip(fl)
                chans.append(v)
        for tr, fl in LAYOUTS:
            chans.append(self.lay(m, tr, fl))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        chans.append(ys.view(1, 1, self.Y, 1).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        chans.append(xs.view(1, 1, 1, self.X).expand(b, 1, self.Y, self.X))
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(chans, dim=1))
        x = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        o = self.out(f)
        place = None
        for k, (tr, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
            p = self.unlay(o[:, k * self.T:(k + 1) * self.T], tr, fl)
            place = p if place is None else place + p
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        place = None
        for k, (tr, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
            p = self.unlay(o[:, k * self.T:(k + 1) * self.T], tr, fl)
            place = p if place is None else place + p
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no results yet. In earlier searches, only one family scored above 0. It feeds the legal-action mask in as input channels under four layouts (as given, transposed, y-flipped, x-flipped) and sums per-type output maps re-laid in those same layouts into the placement logits. This suggests that worlds hide a mismatch between the stated action indexing and the real one. Changes to the recipe, trunk or head alone never helped. Round 1 first reproduces that family faithfully, at a compute ratio near 1 so it keeps the full step budget. Two variants then each change one thing: (a) eight layouts (all dihedral symmetries) instead of four, which covers more possible mismatches; (b) the faithful network trained with 2 PPO epochs, which gives about 1.85 times as many samples. Uniform zeros come from the world, not from seed noise. A nonzero late training success is the first real signal.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials scored about 0. The best, r1c1, scored 0.002 on one seed and 0.000 on the other, with late training success of 0.0006. That is noise, not a signal. The family that scored in an earlier world does not fit this world under its four layouts or under all eight grid symmetries (r1c2). Doubling the samples with 2 PPO epochs (r1c3) did not help either, which agrees with the earlier finding that recipe-only changes fail. So the action indexing probably differs from the spec in a way that a transpose or flip of the [type, Y, X] layout cannot express. The most likely candidates are type-minor ordering (a = (y*X + x)*T + t, or another order of the three axes) and DONE placed at index 0, which shifts every placement index by one. The network learns the observation and footprints, so channel or type permutations should already be handled. This round tests broader layout hedges. All three use the default recipe so that each result can be read cleanly.
analyses.3: Every trial is effectively 0. The four-layout reproduction (r1c1) built 1 of 512 dev designs on one seed, with late training success of 0.0006. That is within seed noise, but it is the only nonzero signal. Covering more action-index layouts did not help: 8 dihedral layouts, 6 axis orders, DONE-first and 24 order-by-flip layouts all scored 0. So either this world differs somewhere these nets do not cover, or the task is just harder here and needs better learning. Two untested ideas fit: the observation's memory layout may be scrambled (channel-last), so convolutions see noise; or r1c1 lacks capacity and credit for the exact-build bonus. One candidate hedges the observation layout, one deepens the trunk and uses 2 PPO epochs to keep the step budget, and one lengthens the credit horizon. Each extends r1c1, so its result can be compared with r1c1.
analyses.4: Nine trials, and all are at noise level. Only r1c1, the four-layout reproduction, scored at all: 0.002 on one seed, about 1 design in 512, with late training success of 0.0006. The 6-order, DONE-first, 24-layout and channel-last observation hedges all scored exactly 0. A simple re-mapping of action indices is probably not the main problem, or it is not the only one. Recipe changes (2 epochs, gamma 0.99) and a deeper trunk also scored 0. Every difference so far is within seed noise. In this last round I keep the r1c1 family and make three different bets. (1) A head that pools over brick footprints, with corner-anchor hedges, so the net can work out landing layers and whether a brick fits the target. (2) Each observation group (build, target, missing, extra) fed under its own flips and transposes, in case parts of the observation are drawn in different orientations. (3) The same network trained on about 3.25 times more environment samples.
